hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '(View\.swift$|/Views/.*\.swift$)'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"SwiftUI view %s was just edited. Please invoke the swiftui-pro skill to review it for best practices."}}\n' "$file"; fi
